# find way to clean stale branches

Add a command that deletes branches by age as well as by merge state:

```bash
$ git clean -6m
# clean all branches already merged into master and all branches where are last commits 6 months ago
```

`git shake` ([[DOT-33]]) removes branches whose commits are all in the default branch; branches abandoned without merging, or merged by squash/rebase so that `--merged` does not recognise them, accumulate. A "last commit older than N months" criterion would catch those.
